blocks.text: Vectors woh physical quantities hain jinhen poori tarah batane ke liye miqdar (magnitude) ke saath simt (direction) bhi batani parti hai.

items: Displacement: kisi cheez ki jagah (position) mein tabdeeli. Is mein lambai, yani faasla (magnitude), aur ek simt hoti hai (misal: 10 m maghrib (west) ki taraf).
Velocity: kisi khaas simt mein cheez ki speed (misal: 50 km h⁻¹ maghrib ki taraf).
Acceleration: velocity badalne ki raftar; velocity speed mein badle, simt mein ya dono mein (misal: 10 m s⁻² oopar ki taraf).
Force: kisi cheez par dhakka (push) ya kheench (pull), jo apni miqdar aur simt se tay hoti hai (misal: 20 N daen taraf).

blocks.text: Vector quantity dikhane ka achha tareeqa vector diagram hai, jis mein vectors ko teer (arrow) se dikhaya jata hai. Teer ki lambai miqdar batati hai aur teer ka sira (head) simt batata hai. Kitab mein vectors mote (bold) harfon se likhe jate hain (jaise V, F) ya harf ke oopar teer bana kar (A⃗).

Kisi vector ka component (hissa) woh hai jitna woh vector kisi di gayi simt mein asar rakhta hai. Ek vector ko kuch muqarrar simton mein apne component vectors ka resultant (majmooi nateeja) samjha ja sakta hai. Aam taur par vector ko aisi do simton mein torte hain jo ek doosre par perpendicular (amood, 90° par) hon. Aise components rectangular components kehlate hain.

Farz karein vector A⃗ ko lakeer OP se dikhaya gaya hai jo x-axis ke saath angle (zaviya) θ banati hai. A⃗ ka x-axis par projection (saya) OM aur y-axis par projection ON banayein (Fig. 2.1). x-simt wala projection OM, A⃗x kehlata hai aur y-simt wala projection ON, A⃗y. Head to tail rule (ek vector ka sira doosre ki dum se jorna) lagane se:

blocks.alt: X aur Y axes O par milte hain. Vector A, O se P tak x-axis se zawiya theta par hai. Us ka component Ax x-axis par O se M tak aur component Ay y-axis par O se N tak hai; nuqta-daar (dashed) lakeerein N ko P se aur P ko M se jorti hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 2.1: Vector A ke rectangular components (kitab ki Figure 2.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Yani A⃗x aur A⃗y vector A⃗ ke components hain. Yeh dono aapas mein 90° par hain, is liye A⃗ ke rectangular components kehlate hain. Right angled triangle OMP mein A⃗x ki miqdar, yani A⃗ ka x-component, yeh hai:
Aur A⃗y ki miqdar, yani A⃗ ka y-component, yeh hai:
Rectangular components se vector maloom karna
Agar kisi vector ke rectangular components diye hon (Fig. 2.1), to Pythagorean theorem se vector ki miqdar nikal sakte hain.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Component nikalna: Ax = A cos θ aur Ay = A sin θ. Wapas vector banana: miqdar A = √(Ax² + Ay²) aur simt θ = tan⁻¹(Ay/Ax). Misal: 20 N ki force 60° par ho to Fx = 20 cos 60° = 10 N aur Fy = 20 sin 60° = 17.3 N.

blocks.title: Example 2.1
blocks.problem: Barabar miqdar wali do forces ke darmiyan angle nikalein jab un ke resultant ki miqdar bhi har ek force ke barabar ho.
steps:
Farz karein F₁ aur F₂ ke darmiyan angle θ hai aur F₁ x-axis ke saath hai. Resultant ka x-component:
Rx = F₁ cos 0° + F₂ cos θ
Rx = F₁ + F₂ cos θ (kyun ke cos 0° = 1)

Resultant ka y-component:
Ry = F₁ sin 0° + F₂ sin θ
Ry = F₂ sin θ (kyun ke sin 0° = 0)
Sawal ke mutabiq R = F₁ = F₂ = F

Is liye F² = (F + F cos θ)² + (F sin θ)²
F² = F² + F²cos²θ + 2F² cos θ + F² sin²θ
Dono taraf se F² kat jata hai: 0 = 2F² cos θ + F² (cos²θ + sin²θ)
cos²θ + sin²θ = 1, is liye 0 = 2F² cos θ + F²
F² se taqseem (divide) karein: cos θ = -0.5
blocks.answer: θ = cos⁻¹(-0.5) = 120°. Yani do barabar forces 120° par hon to un ka resultant bhi utna hi hota hai.

blocks.caption: Vector ke components
rows: Ax = A cos θ, Ay = A sin θ

blocks.prompt: 20 N ki force horizontal (ufqi) se 60° oopar lagti hai. Is ke rectangular components nikalein, phir un se wapas miqdar aur simt nikal kar dekhein.

items: Vector: miqdar aur simt dono (displacement, velocity, acceleration, force); teer se dikhate hain, bold harf ya harf par teer se likhte hain.
Rectangular components: A⃗ = A⃗x + A⃗y, Ax = A cos θ, Ay = A sin θ; wapas: A = √(Ax² + Ay²), θ = tan⁻¹(Ay/Ax).
Example 2.1: do barabar forces ka resultant bhi utna hi ho to un ke darmiyan angle 120° hai.
